dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Sinister, Predatory)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Grief makes people careless, and carelessness is exactly what I need from that household right now.

dialogue_segments.label: AGNES (Anxious, Whispering)
dialogue_segments.speaker: AGNES
dialogue_segments.text: My lady... the Duke has bailiffs watching every road out of the county.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Confident, Devious)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: I'm not leaving the county, Agnes. I'm going back into that house.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Pleased, Scheming)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Father Thomas did his part beautifully today.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Calculated, Demanding)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Now I need him to do a little more before that hearing convenes.

dialogue_segments.label: AGNES (Apprehensive)
dialogue_segments.speaker: AGNES
dialogue_segments.text: If someone sees him come to you...

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Stern, Threatening)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Then no one sees him.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Authoritative)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: That is precisely your job tonight.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Hushed, Commanding)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Send for the priest. Tonight.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Firm, Final)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: And make sure no one sees him arrive.
